name: Launch (SDLC Phase 11)
description: Executing the product launch — aka Go-Live, GA, Rollout, Ignite.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Launch Management
capabilities.description: Executes the coordinated go-live of the product, including rollout sequencing, monitoring, and incident readiness.

checklists.name: Launch (SDLC Phase 11) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for launch readiness, deployment rollout, monitoring, and incident commander alignment.

items.statement: The launch checklist, rollout plan, and incident response plan are complete and all owners have confirmed readiness.
Deployment rollout script has been executed successfully in staging environment with automated verification.
On-call incident commander and response team are actively monitoring war-room channels during rollout.
Real-time monitoring dashboards and alerting thresholds are verified live before traffic shift.
Customer communications, release notes, and status page updates are scheduled and pre-approved.

reviewGates.name: Launch Readiness Review
reviewGates.statement: The Deployment Package and rollout plan have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Hypercare & Stabilization.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the Deployment Package, along with the incident response and monitoring plans, sufficiently ready to justify launching?
